summary: Hyperscale Data filed an 8-K to report entering into a Master Services Agreement with a customer to deploy ~20 MW of AI computing capacity at its Dowagiac data center. The agreement includes a 10-year initial term with two five-year options, an exclusive license to the service area, and a right of first offer on an additional 32 MW. No special-situation categories apply as this is a routine commercial contract, not a transformative event like an acquisition, spin-off, or restructuring.
